About Kayla

Kind greetings, friend.

"I started Practical Magic as a means to help set the stage in everyday life — knowing it's the small tasks that too often hold us back."

I'm Kayla. My career journey began in non-profit theatre, where I built my values in organization, time-management, attention to detail, and communication. Now I lend a dependable hand to my neighbours in Toronto's west end.

Start focusing on the role you were meant to fulfill — and let the stage hands take care of the rest.
